name: Venice and its Lagoon
description: Venice is a city in northeastern Italy built across more than a hundred small islands in a shallow lagoon, where canals serve as streets and hundreds of bridges link the districts. Founded in the 5th century, it grew into a wealthy maritime power, and its palaces and churches still hold paintings by masters such as Titian, Tintoretto and Veronese. Simply wandering its waterways is the main attraction.
